findings.failure_mode: Pan/zoom has no proof the synthetic gesture moved the map: a no-op touch reads ~60 fps idle as a PASS (opus2#1).
findings.fix_evidence: Hash the composited map canvas region

findings.failure_mode: The claim 'turf & d3-contour absent from the client bundle' is untested and FALSE: reach.ts statically imports @turf/boolean-point-in-polygon, name-mangled by minification so a name grep misses it (opus2#2).
findings.fix_evidence: turf/d3 detection by name is BEST-EFFORT

findings.failure_mode: The cold 'p95' at n=12 is literally the max sample (ceil(0.95*12)-1 = 11) (opus2#3, sonnet2#1, sol2#5, terra).
Gap #8's call-chain citation is wrong: for mode=walk resolveClip returns rings:null; the ORS call is in clipRingsFor on the amenities cache miss (opus2#4).
'Median of 5' reuses one page with the HTTP cache on, so runs 2-5 are warm (opus2#5).
Render-free is judged on raw commit counts over unequal windows instead of a commit RATE over an idle window sized to the gesture (sonnet2#2, re-raised from round 1).
The worst-frame verdict uses the MEDIAN of per-run worsts; an absolute 'no frame > 32 ms' budget must use the MAX across all runs (sol2#2).
Isochrone/car request failures are swallowed and followed by a fixed wait, so a failed flow is reported as a successful measurement (sol2#3, terra2#2).
findings.fix_evidence: refusing to report a failed ring-reveal

findings.failure_mode: Failed API samples are discarded and a passing p95 is computed from the surviving subset instead of failing closed (terra2#3, sol2#4).
The real-device path measures over adb reverse (USB), not a real 4G RTT, while the doc implies real-radio latency (sol2#1, terra2#1).

known_rejects.why_rejected: A known small overcount that does not move the 470.7 KB verdict; dropped by the judges' own caps.
